info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Application Withdrawal API
info.description: This API allows users to initiate the withdrawal of loan applications. By providing the specific loan application ID, consumers can seamlessly process withdrawal requests in real-time. It serves as a key resource for financial institutions and customer service platforms managing loan inquiries and applications. Typical users include loan officers and automated systems that handle customer requests for modifying or retracting applications, ensuring better user experience and operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows the withdrawal of a specific loan application identified by its unique ID. Once the request is processed, the loan application will be marked as withdrawn and will no longer be processed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the withdrawal of a loan application identified by RES-100045. It should include all necessary information to process the withdrawal, ensuring compliance with the required schema definitions.

200.description: The loan application has been successfully withdrawn.
